turns.prompt_text: website for lifeserve blood center in Ankeny Iowa
turns.response_html: The website for LifeServe Blood Center in Ankeny, Iowa is http://lifeservebloodcenter.org/.

The Red Cross does not have a dedicated donation center in Ankeny, but they do hold mobile blood drives. The nearest permanent Red Cross location is the Northern and Central Iowa Chapter office in Des Moines. You can check the Red Cross Blood website or download their app to find upcoming blood drives in your area.

turns.prompt_text: when is the next blood drive in Ankeny Iowa
turns.response_html:
While a permanent Red Cross donation center does not exist in Ankeny, you can find upcoming Red Cross blood drives by checking their website.

LifeServe Blood Center has a permanent donation center in Ankeny at 1555 SE Delaware Ave, Suite J. You can schedule an appointment to donate there on various days throughout the week. Upcoming mobile blood drives in the Central Iowa area include the "Sunday Save Day August" event on August 24 and a "Big Game Blood Drive" on September 2. You can check the LifeServe Blood Center and Red Cross websites for a full list of upcoming blood drives and to schedule an appointment.
